transcript.text: I need to flag several critical gaps in the draft agreement from a privacy standpoint. While reviewing the proposed data flows against our privacy inventory, I confirmed that the platform will process identifiable customer call transcripts. Our approved data-processing standard therefore requires: (1) deletion of all customer data within exactly 7 calendar days after termination, (2) an explicit prohibition on the vendor using customer content for model training or service improvement, and (3) processing exclusively within the European Union. None of these three requirements have yet been entered into the contract redline. These are non-negotiable under our standard, and I'll need them addressed before I can submit a formal privacy finding to the case record.
